name: SIGSEGV
author: Sminx
description: LDM ONLY: Buffer a hold when you get teleported at 32% to jump over the invisible size portal at 33%. Briefly hold the dash orb at the very beginning of the section at 34% to fall upwards. Time a hold again to go right below the saws at 35%. Stop holding right before you land on the bottom of the slope at 36% to get sent out of the level between the invisible spikes. Fall near the ceiling and hold until the end.
